name: BotBellum
summary:
BotBellum is a browser-based strategy game focused on training AI commanders for automated combat. Players build commanders, configure their training, and publish them to compete in ranked fights across a three-lane battlefield with units, towers, and a core.

Features include training without coding, customizable commander brains and training objectives, Elo rankings, fight replays, and a mode where players fight directly against AI commanders.
